      simp [map_smul, hT]

      rw [← haction]
      exact hstable W hx hy hh i j w hw
    have hdiv := W.smul_mem ((beta.repr w j)⁻¹) hmem
    simpa [smul_smul, hj] using hdiv
  apply top_unique
  intro z hz
  rw [← beta.sum_repr z]
  exact W.sum_mem fun i hi => W.smul_mem _ (hb i)

  (act : ↥Reduction.SL →ₗ⁅ℂ⁆ End ℂ V) (x y h : ↥Reduction.SL) (v0 : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  Nat.Prime p →

                  Reduction.endpoint K (act x) (act y) (act h) M
